topic: 限时听力：学术独白与阶段测评
grammarFocus: 学术句子的主干、修饰关系与名词短语；被动表达。
title: Timed Listening and Staged Assessment in University Study
prompt: Some universities now assess students through short, strictly timed listening tests in which they hear an academic monologue once and then answer questions, rather than through longer coursework assignments completed at home. Some educators argue that these timed listening assessments give a fairer and more accurate picture of a student's real academic ability. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this view? In your answer, state your own position clearly and support it with relevant reasons and examples drawn from education or assessment more generally. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。写作前请先明确你的立场（同意、不同意或部分同意），并在引言段直接表明。主体段每段聚焦一个理由，用教育或测评情境中的具体例子支撑，避免空泛罗列。讨论“限时听力测评是否更公平、更准确”时，可从评分一致性、考试焦虑、真实学术场景的对应程度、以及一次性听力对残障学生的影响等角度展开。结尾段重申立场并概括主要论据，不要引入全新观点。全文至少250词，建议用约40分钟完成，写完后检查立场是否贯穿全文、例子是否与论点直接相关。
